headline: Cohere reports a C$4 billion Canada investment and 1,500-plus job plan through 2031
summary: In an Oct 30, 2026 company post, Cohere described an update to its Canada investment effort, which it said began in 2024. The company expects the multi-year effort to create more than 1,500 jobs and deliver more than C$4 billion in research-and-development and AI-infrastructure investment through 2031, including at least 1,000 technical roles. These are company projections, not independently verified spending or hiring outcomes. Cohere does not quantify how much is new against the existing effort. The government announced a separate staged equity investment on Oct 29; the public sources reviewed do not reconcile overlap between the plans or with the prior C$725 million compute project.
